description: This file defines 'LookupActivity', an Android activity that serves as a user interface for browsing Wiktionary content. It handles user interactions, navigation history, asynchronous page loading, and integrates animations and menu options to provide an interactive dictionary lookup experience.

classes.name: LookupActivity
classes.description: An Android activity class providing a user interface for browsing Wiktionary entries, managing navigation history, and handling UI animations and menu options.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity UI components, loads animations, prepares user agent, and handles incoming intents to start word navigation.

methods.name: onKeyDown
methods.description: Overrides default key handling to manage backward navigation through the history stack or close activity.

methods.name: startNavigating
methods.description: Triggers asynchronous lookup of a given word, optionally pushing current entry to history.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu for search, random word, and about actions.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles selection of menu options to perform various actions like search, random word lookup, or showing about dialog.

methods.name: showAbout
methods.description: Displays an about dialog with credits and data source information.

methods.name: onNewIntent
methods.description: Handles new intents, including search queries or internal links, to start corresponding navigation.

methods.name: setEntryTitle
methods.description: Updates the activity's title with the current dictionary entry.

methods.name: setEntryContent
methods.description: Loads the provided HTML content into the WebView for display.
